hook: After *35 days* of protest, polytechnics stay with Education
hook_b: After *35 days* of protest, polytechnics stay with Education
tldr: Telangana issued an order on Friday keeping government polytechnics under the Higher Education Department instead of Young India Skills University.

beats.what: Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju's order puts both YISU and government polytechnics under the Higher Education Department.
beats.why: Teachers said polytechnic pay scales and cadres, including AICTE scales, differ from ITIs, and students feared the merger would lower their status.
beats.care: The decision followed recommendations of a committee headed by K Keshava Rao, which met the Polytechnic JAC and students.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: YISU has been told to get AICTE and other approvals to expand its academic programmes.

qs: What happens to polytechnic staff promotions after the order?
Will YISU still offer diploma courses?

facts.t: Polytechnic students and staff had protested for *about 35 days*.

steps.e: Polytechnics, ITIs, ATCs merged into YISU
K Keshava Rao panel meets JAC

viz.verdict: Protesters' main demand met; ITIs stay with Shakti dept

learn.t: YISU = Young India Skills University, a public-private skills university.

watch: Whether the Polytechnic JAC ends its protest and YISU gets AICTE approvals.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana retains polytechnics under Education department after month-long protests

fact: After *35 days* of protests, polytechnics return to Education department control
twist: ITIs and ATCs stay under the Shakti department, but *YISU* still sets their curriculum.
